setup_face_detection_extension: setup a FaceDetectionExtension that initializes MediaPipe face detection and objectron tracking
process_frame_face_detection: process a numpy array frame with MediaPipe face detection and return ExtensionResult
draw_face_detection_overlay: draw face detection bounding boxes on a frame using MediaPipe drawing utilities
check_face_detection_output: check if face detection result data has valid detections with proper length
register_face_detection_args: register the --face_detection CLI argument to enable the face detection extension
